ideas: Replay a valid, previously anchored checkpoint against a fresh ledger fork by reusing its Sigstore bundle and Internet Archive snapshot, to test whether verifiers bind anchors to the exact run ID and chain head.
Feed a government data source a schema-valid but semantically shifted reading (e.g. a silent unit or base-year change) to test whether the pipeline detects discontinuities before sealing the rule.
Have a community agent exfiltrate data via timing or output-size side channels inside the no-network sandbox, to test whether the sandbox limits covert channels as well as direct network access.
